The archivist set the map on the table and stepped back, as if it might bite.

Elena did not touch it. She read it the way she read every map: edges first,
then the lies. In the corner, in a hand that was unmistakably her own, the map
named a country that had never existed.

"Where did you get this?" she asked.

Marcus did not answer. He only looked at the door.
